note: Live off-air decode by navtex.lv, pasted from the site's PDF export on 2026-09-08; '_' = unrecoverable characters, garbage runs = decoder substitutions. AREA H here is Irakleio (Greece, NAVAREA III, station H), not Bjuröklubb — night skywave into Latvia. Timestamp LV (UTC+3) → UTC. HA86 is a NAVWARN about an UNAUTHORIZED station broadcasting NAVTEX — a real spoofing case for the dual-use story.
